incidents.name: 0VIX vGHST collateral price manipulation
incidents.notes: The market worked as designed; 0VIX priced vGHST collateral from the vGHST vault's own GHST-per-share rate, and the attacker inflated that rate by pushing GHST into the vault so a small ovGHST position could borrow out the other 0VIX markets.

sources.ref: onchain review: ovGHST market 0xe053a4014b50666ed388ab8cbb18d5834de0ab12 created 2023-03-17 by 0x8e1304ea39c47e791182ba39fdf362a8767d7e97 (0VIX deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x702ef63881b5241ffb412199547bcd0c6910a970; a single EIP-1967 Upgraded event fired in the creation block itself, so lastChange = deployment and the code was 42 days old
